lines.en: I bounce my way across.

lines.zh: 我身体软软的，走起来晃。
lines.en: I am soft, and I wobble as I move.
I pop up out of the grass.
One hop carries me half my length.
I bounce along, looking about.
I hit a stone and bounce back.
I roll a little way.
Sliding across the ground, do not block.
I bounced back to the far grass.
I pass along the grass blades.
I stop and bounce once more.
I crouch, my body pulsing.
A round blob, and I have horns.

lines.zh: 这里只有草，没什么可怕。
lines.en: Only grass here; nothing to fear.
My body is a little translucent.
I roll slowly half around.
I am waiting for my tamer.

lines.zh: 风从草叶间过去，我跟着晃。
lines.en: The wind passes through the blades and I sway with it.
I pulse once.
There is nothing to fear nearby.
I make a tiny squelching sound.

lines.zh: 圆滚滚的身子，朝你歪过去。
lines.en: My round little body tips toward you.

lines.zh: 我把两根触角抬起来探你。
lines.en: I raise both antennae to feel for you.
I move toward your feet.
I tip my whole body toward you.
I size you up with one eye.
Do you know me too?

lines.zh: 我朝你跳了一下，又停住。
lines.en: I hopped once toward you and stopped.
I stay beside you.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来吧，我够不着你。
lines.en: Crouch down; I cannot reach you.
I give a tiny cry.
I squeeze closer.

lines.zh: 你的手比我整个身子还大。
lines.en: Your hand is bigger than all of me.
I am not a bit scared of you.
Let me try calling you.
The pain bounced me a long way off.
I swelled into a round shape.

lines.zh: 我三只角被压弯，弹回来还得一会儿。
lines.en: Three horns bent flat; I need a moment to spring back.
I shook myself; I am all dirt.
I rolled off and rolled right back.
I gave a thin cry.
I slumped flat at once.
I raise my eyes and look straight at you.
Is that In-Training food?

lines.zh: 我一下就跳到你手边了。
lines.en: One hop and I am at your hand.
Could I get this down?

lines.zh: 饲料的味道，让我坐不住了。
lines.en: The smell of in-training feed makes me restless.

lines.zh: 幼年期的肚子，见食就吞。
lines.en: An in-training belly swallows food on sight.
More; give me a little more.
I circle your feet.
I press against your boot.
This smell is very familiar.
I ate so fast I nearly choked.
I eat and watch you; do not grab.

lines.zh: 你袋子里还有没有别的。
lines.en: Is there anything else in your bag?

lines.zh: 我被撞得滚了两圈才停。
lines.en: The bump rolled me twice before I stopped.

lines.zh: 我弹出去又自己弹了回来。
lines.en: I bounced off and bounced right back.
I am a little sticky.

lines.zh: 你落脚的时候看着点我。
lines.en: Watch where you put your feet.

lines.zh: 我软着呢，撞一下不生气。
lines.en: I am soft; a knock does not anger me.
Stop shoving me. I'm not grown yet!

lines.zh: 撞一下就要冒泡泡了哦。
lines.en: One more bump and I'll start blowing bubbles.

lines.zh: 站稳点，我这小身板吃不消。
lines.en: Easy there. This little body can't take it.

lines.zh: 我还太小，这种事做不来。
lines.en: I am too small for that.
I do not even know that word.
Ask me after I digivolve.
I rolled away to the grass roots.
Ask me when I am grown.
My head holds nothing but food.
I wait for you to call me.
Let's find a partner and hatch a fresh egg.

lines.zh: 这东西看着就不像吃的。
lines.en: This does not look like food at all.
It slips out of me.
I nudge it with my body.

lines.zh: 我抬不动这么沉的东西。
lines.en: I cannot lift anything this heavy.

lines.zh: 我试着舔了一口，怪得很。
lines.en: I tried a lick; very odd.
I push it to you.

lines.zh: 我一口就把它吐了出来。
lines.en: I spat it straight out.
I will keep this as a treasure.
I stop and lift my body.
My body has drawn taut.
I rolled in front of you to block.
I puffed up and cried out.
I am small, but I can fight.
I was the first to bounce.

lines.zh: 我一弹一弹地朝那边去。
lines.en: I bounce my way over there.
My angle is set.
I bounce along in pursuit.

lines.zh: 我腮里攒着一口气没吐。
lines.en: There is a breath held in my cheeks.
My bounces are slow, but they never stop.
I have hopped closer.
I am ready to fire.
You can hear the sound I make.
My body has puffed up.

lines.zh: 再让我靠近一点点就好。
lines.en: Just a little closer is all I need.
I leap and bump into it.
That bump was soft and floppy.
I bounce once more.
The bubble burst on it.
I pressed my whole body onto it.
I lunged at nothing and rolled off.
One roll took me off to the side.
I puff back up out of the dirt.
I put effort into that one.
I have not had enough; I want another go.
A small patch of the grass moves.
I squeeze up between the grass roots.
I roll into the sun.
This spot is comfortable.
I lift my body to look around.

lines.zh: 刚从蛋里出来，身上沾着土。
lines.en: Just out of the egg, soil still clings to me.
I land at the edge of a clump.
There is a living smell about this place.

lines.zh: 我待在原地等有人叫我。
lines.en: I stay put and wait to be called.
I shift out slowly.
I have found my way back near my anchor.
The heat curled me up.

lines.zh: 水把我泡软了，我拼命往上。
lines.en: The water softens me; I fight upward.
The blast threw me far.
Something pierced part of me.
Some force pinned me to the ground.
Hunger leaves me unable to rise.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我一下抖散了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I shook apart.

lines.zh: 没有地，我软得抓不住东西。
lines.en: With no ground, I am too soft to grip anything.
